name: WHO emergencies
summary: One WHO public health emergency of international concern in force: Bundibugyo Ebola
state: WHO's emergency of international concern for the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, declared in May, remains in force under IHR Emergency Committee recommendations of 24 Aug, and WHO's 6 Nov outbreak update reports continued spread (WHO; ECDC). No new PHEIC had been declared in the 30 days to 8 Nov.
for_you: Follow NHS and NaTHNaC travel health advice if travelling to affected countries.
rubric_hit: A PHEIC in effect, none new in 30 days = Watch

why: A WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) or 'pandemic emergency' is the top official global health alarm.
drivers: Outbreak spread, IHR Emergency Committee decisions.

rubric.alert: A new PHEIC declared in the past 30 days, or a pandemic emergency declared.
rubric.watch: A PHEIC in effect, or an IHR Emergency Committee convened.
rubric.normal: No PHEIC in effect other than long-running polio.
